decisions.reason: As a flagship adapter closely tied to the firm’s core track-lighting system, it is strategically important and relatively cheap to keep as an option while continuing to support the broader premium lighting platform.
This LED luminaire line is close to the established business and likely inexpensive to retain in the catalogue, so under continued uncertainty management would more likely keep it than abandon it.

The home automation server box is the most technology- and support-intensive product here, and by 2022 management would be more willing to abandon it if adoption has not clearly justified further commitment.
A luminaire family fits the firm’s premium interior-lighting core and preserves design and channel options, so management would usually keep it unless sales evidence had clearly turned negative.
